supplementalBreakdowns.basis: Forty-nine nonzero FY2024 program and facility actuals total $461,232,548 of audited General Fund cash disbursements. The published Court Operations and Local Facilities leaf cells are each $1 below their printed subtotals, leaving the displayed rows $2 below the $461,232,550 General Fund control; those source discrepancies are preserved without balancing rows. Kentucky's prescribed regulatory cash basis remains a separate supplemental—not additive—view of the Census function.

supplementalBreakdowns.title: CMS-64 federal Medicaid share by service · 4 rows
supplementalBreakdowns.basis: Final FY2024 CMS-64 rows total $14,294,705,917 for Kentucky's federal Medicaid share. CMS does not publicly release category-of-service quarters, so any annual row still above $10B is an explicit public disclosure ceiling rather than an invented split. Medicaid is a major component of public welfare, but this federal-share boundary is supplemental—not additive—to the broader Census state-government function.

supplementalBreakdowns.title: Kentucky SFY2024 Medicaid benefits actuals by payment type
supplementalBreakdowns.basis: Kentucky Medicaid reports $18.1971049B of SFY2024 actual benefits. The base managed-care row is the published $14.3185435B MCO total less its three published directed-payment components; the seven rows reconcile to the presentation's benefits total within its $100 precision and cross-check within $71.06 of the state transparency ledger. This benefits-only view is supplemental—not additive—to Census public welfare or CMS federal-year reporting.
